title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00097 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: POOH with DHSV assy and l/d same
00:30 - 02:30: POOH with 9 STD 7" tubing from 1896 mmd to 1579 mmd, r/b stands. Average pulling speed 13,2 jnts/hr. Measured for LRA every 3 STD. Experienced issues with casing tong unable to grip properly to break connections.
02:30 - 04:00: POOH with 1 STD 7" tubing from 1579 mmd to 1543 mmd, r/b stands. Worked on casing tong and changed dies.
04:00 - 07:00: POOH with 14 STD 7" tubing from 1543 mmd to 1035 mmd. Average pulling speed 14 jnts/hr. Measured for LRA every 3 STD.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed handover meeting with ongoing crew.
07:15 - 07:30: Performed equpment check on PRS and casing tong prior to continuing pulling 7" tubing.
07:30 - 08:45: POOH with 4 STD 7" tubing from 1035 mmd to 881 mmd.
08:45 - 09:30: Isolated equipment and performed drops check on TDS and FWD PRS
09:30 - 10:00: POOH with 2 STD 7" tubing from 881 mmd to 811 mmd.
10:00 - 11:30: Investigated damages after tugger wire caught up in FWT PRS.
11:30 - 14:00: Inspected and checked for loose items on top of FWD PRS
14:00 - 14:30: R/u slings and load cell to test the PRS shaft for any damage test)
14:30 - 14:45: Performed TBT for testing the PRS shaft
14:45 - 15:30: Preformed pull test on FWD PRS r/d load cell
15:30 - 15:45: Performed TBT prior to moving PRS to park position
15:45 - 17:00: Installed enerpac to upper breaks to lift breaks on upper PRS trolley. Moved PRS to parked position. R/d tuggers from PRS.
17:00 - 17:30: Prepared tools and equipment to remove control block.
17:30 - 17:45: Performed TBT for removing control block on PRS. Meanwhile prepared wire for wire change on green tugger.
17:45 - 19:00: Removed block from FWD PRS. Meanwhile cleaned and cleared in locker and moonpool area.
19:00 - 19:45: Performed TBT with all involved personnel for PRS repair
19:45 - 23:45: Removed control block from FWD PRS. Meanwhile prepared for changing wire on green tugger. Performed housekeeping in drilling areas. Performed PMS in
